title: Implement a checkpointed workflow state machine

blocks.text: A transaction claims one dependency-ready node; explicit recovery returns interrupted work to pending. The task is: Return a SQLite-backed workflow-state store. Dependencies map node to prerequisite IDs; require an acyclic graph. claim() transactionally claims one ready pending node; finish(node,success) persists terminal state; recover() explicitly resets interrupted running nodes to pending. Schema/dependency configuration must match on reopen. This core assumes recovery is called only when old workers are stopped; effects are a separate exercise.

The inputs are `path`, `dependencies`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.

Before following the implementation, identify the output's shape and meaning. Then identify which input values can affect one selected output. This gives you a testable mental model before the code adds implementation detail.
